model: ER-negative HER2-positive breast cancer models, including HCC1954 and resistant backgrounds
intervention: EDI3/GPCPD1 siRNA or inducible knockdown; dipyridamole assessed separately
outcome: Genetic silencing reduced viability and xenograft growth in studied models.
limits: Subtype-specific preclinical context. Dipyridamole is not selective for EDI3; its drug effects cannot all be attributed to GPCPD1. No proof that CAMP GPC association mediates tumor effects.
decision: Supports context-specific inhibition hypothesis; not a new target discovery in this project.
evidence_relationship: Related research program to 2024 paper; do not count as independent clinical validation.

model: HCC1954 inducible knockdown; SUM190PT in vitro; tail-vein and intraperitoneal experimental metastasis in mice
intervention: Inducible shRNA and additional siRNA experiments
outcome: Reduced anoikis resistance, metastatic burden and improved survival in the peritoneal model; GPC accumulation after EDI3 silencing.
limits: No migration reduction in the studied HER2-positive cells. Experimental injection models omit early spontaneous metastasis steps; lung signal eventually declined in all groups. Authors explicitly leave GPC-mediated phenotype unproven.
decision: Stronger functional background than migration-only description, but novelty and mechanism remain separate questions.
evidence_relationship: Extends 2023 work and shares models/authors; not fully independent replication.

model: Breast cancer cell models in haptoglobin/glycolysis study
outcome: Reported reduced migration/invasion and increased chemotherapy sensitivity.
limits: Full-text retrieval unavailable during this pass. Does not establish broad single-agent killing, normal-tissue safety, or mediation by CAMP sugar phosphates.
decision: Retain functional support with abstract-level review limitation; not newly discovered breast cancer biology.
evidence_relationship: Same study as original first-pass evidence; recheck is not a new independent study.
